Cleveland Touring Club Monday Rocky River Social Ride

Lakewood, OH · Road · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Cleveland Touring Club Monday Rocky River Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Lakewood, OH. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Emerald Necklace (Rocky River) Marina parking lot. Pace: beginner 10–12 mph and advanced beginner 12–14 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cleveland Touring Club Monday Rocky River Social Ride group ride

A new Monday ride on Cleveland's west side. Out and back through the Rocky River Reservation. Two beginner paces, no-drop, all welcome. Weather calls go out over the club's WhatsApp group.
